text:
Marta (ML): Heads up — starting onboarding for Raptor-21B. Goal: host + dedicated. Need a quant int4 bring-up, perf sweep (batching / ctx length), and quality checks. Quick note: saw ~6% drop on codegen pass@1 vs our float16 baseline on dev-code-200. Creating thread to track triage.

Deepa: Can you paste the eval CLI + config you ran?

Marta (ML): Sure, quick smoke I ran locally:

```
./bench/run_eval.sh --model raptor-21b --precision int4 --tasks codegen,commonbench --ctx 8192 --batch-sizes 1,4,8
```

Quick output (small sample):
```
throughput: 450 tok/s @ batch=1 ctx=2048
latency p50: 48ms p95: 220ms
codegen pass@1: 0.44 (baseline float16: 0.47)
```

Liam: Thanks. First thoughts: kernels look fine, but KV-cache packing seems suboptimal for ctx > 4096 — could inflate latency and change token sampling timing. Did you try running without KV warmup?

Marta (ML): Not yet. I suspect our per-layer activation clipping in the quant profile might be killing rare token logits. Adding Deepa to debug.

Deepa: I'll run a micro-sweep: per-layer clip variants + 16-bit bias-restore. ETA ~2 hrs. Will post script here.

benchbot: Automated microbench finished (sample run):
- int4 + clip_v1 -> p95 latency 210ms, throughput 480 tok/s
- int4 + bias_restore -> p95 190ms, throughput 460 tok/s

Anand: For batching, try continuous batching with max_batch=16 and timeout_ms=12. Also test prefix caching optimization for short-turn convs; that often improves throughput for chat workloads.

Marta (ML): Agreed. Also need calibration-quality eval (cal-lab) on the prompt set "dev-code-200". Who can own that? @Ryan?

Ryan: I can take cal-lab + tox eval. Will run full suite tonight and share diffs.

Marta (ML): Action items (initial):
- Deepa: run per-layer clip sweep + bias restore (in progress)
- Deepa / Liam: verify KV-cache packing & warmup behavior for ctx > 4096
- Ryan: run cal-lab on dev-code-200 and report pass@k delta vs float16 baseline
- Anand: produce batching profile with continuous batching configs and max_batch sweeps
- Marta: open candidate quant-profile PR and attach telemetry + eval diffs

Deepa: Noted. I'll post logs + flamegraphs to the PR and include the micro-sweep table.

deploy-bot: Allocated 2x A100 to raptor21b-qual-run for 3 hours (job id: rb21-qual-20260320-01)

Marta (ML): Let's sync at 4:00pm PT. If regressions persist, fallback policy -> float16 for the codegen route and continue int4 for non-code routes.

Liam: Also add a unit smoke: "codegen-smoke" that runs 10 short prompts and checks token distribution + end-of-sequence timing. Quick test should catch sampling shifts.

Marta (ML): Good call. I'll add that to the onboarding checklist and require passing before promoting quant profile.

Ryan: If cal-lab delta > 3% absolute on pass@1, gate the release and flag for model-research review. I'll report by EOD.

Marta (ML): PR link when ready: https://git.internal/repo/raptor21b/quant-pr (will update with artifacts)

Deepa: Quick update — observed NaN spikes during int4 conv on layer 18 in one run. Tracing now to see if it's a per-tile overflow or a packing bug.

Marta (ML): ACK. Keep posting traces and the failing inputs. If we see deterministic NaNs, hold the profile. :thumbsup:

Liam: Also suggest adding a short jitter in batching timer to avoid pathological coalescing during our synthetic bench.

Marta (ML): Noted. Thanks all — will keep thread updated.
